description: Shared manifest v2 vectors (C3, D1 §5): strict v1 preserved, v2 validation with stable error codes, the resolved view, the call-time invocation-context check and the invoke answer-payload refusal. Consumers assert error codes, never wording.
mutation_semantics: Each case starts from a deep copy of base_manifests[base] and applies mutations in order. Paths are RFC 6901 JSON Pointers. op=set replaces or adds the member or array element at path; a final token '-' appends to the array. op=remove deletes the member. The result is serialized as canonical JSON (sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace, UTF-8) and passed to the loader as bytes.

error_codes.manifest_invalid: Not exactly one JSON object; a non-finite number; an unknown or wrongly typed field (null included) at any modeled level; a v2 field in v1; event_emitters in v2; or any v1 rule.
error_codes.tool_contexts_invalid: invocation_contexts is empty, has duplicates or a value other than agent, surface, hook.
error_codes.surface_invalid: A surface field value, bound, input binding or event binding is invalid.
error_codes.surface_tool_invalid: A surface tool is unresolved, lacks the surface context, is public, or has the wrong method or mutation flag.
error_codes.answer_tool_contexts_invalid: A surface answer_tool does not declare invocation_contexts exactly ["surface"]. Checked before surface_tool_invalid for the answer tool.
error_codes.answer_route_agent_visible: A v2 tool whose contexts include agent has the method of a surface answer_tool and a path that can match the same requests (segments equal, or either a placeholder).
error_codes.answer_input_forbidden: A v2 tool other than a surface answer_tool declares an answer property, top-level or in an object body parameter's schema; or a surface names its invoke_tool as its answer_tool.
error_codes.usage_invalid: usage format is missing or invalid, or its snapshot tool is unresolved, public or a mutation.
error_codes.lifecycle_invalid: lifecycle is empty, or a lifecycle tool is unresolved, public, or has the wrong mutation flag.
error_codes.hooks_invalid: The hooks slot has an unsupported registration_version, a bound, name, version, scope or duplicate violation.
error_codes.hook_tool_invalid: A registration tool is not a local tool declaring exactly ["hook"], or a production read is not a local non-mutating tool.
error_codes.app_keys_invalid: An app key has an invalid or duplicate kid, an invalid did:key, or missing, duplicate or malformed purposes.
error_codes.attestation_invalid: Call-time: a principal attestation is present but its verifier rejected it; never downgraded to no attestation.
error_codes.tool_context_denied: Call-time: the caller context is not in the tool's invocation_contexts.
error_codes.channel_invalid: Call-time: a principal attestation is present but its channel is missing, not a string or unknown.
error_codes.tool_not_found: Call-time: the tool is not declared.
error_codes.answer_payload_refused: Call-time, a cheap guard only: a request body for a v2 tool other than a surface answer_tool carries an answer member, top-level or in a top-level object member. It does not recognise an answer-kind action submitted through invoke; refusing those is the naapp's own invoke handler's job, from its action definitions.

resolved_shape: agent_tools, surface_tools and hook_tools list tool names in manifest order. app_keys lists keys in manifest order with purposes as declared; a v1 event_emitters entry resolves to purposes ["app-event"]. Surface event types resolve to <app.id>/<type>. Absent optional references resolve to null; absent usage, lifecycle and hooks resolve to null, absent registrations, productions and reads to [].
call_semantics: attestation is null when the request carries no aweb.principal-attestation/1, else {verified, payload}: verified is the outcome of the attestation verifier (secrets.md §4.6), which this check does not implement, and payload is the attestation payload. A present attestation that did not verify is attestation_invalid, never treated as absent. A verified payload's top-level channel claim maps dashboard to caller context surface, and mcp_l2 or api to agent; no attestation means agent. Any other channel fails closed. The tool is allowed when the caller context is in its invocation_contexts (context_allowed). A hook-only tool is never callable through this check. The check only refuses: context_allowed grants nothing, and the call still faces the app's grants, roles, policy and any attestation requirement of its own.

cases.name: v2_fixture_resolves
cases.description: The D1 fixture: contexts, surfaces, usage, lifecycle, hooks slot and purpose-split keys all resolve.

cases.name: v1_strict_still_accepted
cases.description: A v1 manifest resolves every tool as agent+surface and reads event_emitters as app-event keys only.

cases.name: v2_minimal_tools_only
cases.description: Every v2 capability field is optional; absent invocation_contexts means agent+surface.

cases.name: v2_surface_event_local_type
cases.description: A surface event may name the app-local type; it resolves to the qualified type.

cases.name: v2_surface_without_invoke_or_answer
cases.description: A read-only surface needs no invoke or answer tool and no invocation input.

cases.name: v2_unknown_surface_format_accepted
cases.description: An unknown format is valid manifest data; a host that does not know it shows the surface as unavailable.

cases.name: v2_unknown_key_purpose_grants_nothing_but_parses
cases.description: An unrecognized purpose is retained for the admin to see; verifiers accept a key only for purposes they implement.

cases.name: v2_hook_tool_not_registered_is_pending_inert
cases.description: A hook-only tool with no registration resolves; it is still never an agent or surface tool.

cases.name: v1_rejects_invocation_contexts
cases.description: v2 fields are unknown fields in v1.

cases.name: v2_rejects_event_emitters
cases.description: v2 replaces event_emitters with app_keys.

cases.name: v2_duplicate_tool_name
cases.description: Every lookup of a v2 tool by name must find the same tool, so names are unique.

cases.name: contexts_null
cases.description: Wrong JSON types, null included, are manifest_invalid; value rules have their own codes.

cases.name: surface_read_tool_hook_only
cases.description: Surfaces reference only tools whose contexts include surface.

cases.name: surface_tool_public
cases.description: Public/unsigned tools cannot serve member pages.

cases.name: surface_read_tool_mutation
cases.description: list/read are member-authenticated non-mutating GETs.

cases.name: surface_answer_tool_is_invoke_tool
cases.description: The invoke tool is agent-visible, so naming it as the answer tool is an agent-visible answer path.

cases.name: answer_tool_default_contexts
cases.description: Absent contexts mean agent+surface: an agent-visible answer path.

cases.name: answer_tool_agent_only
cases.description: The answer-tool context rule is checked before the generic surface rule.

cases.name: invoke_tool_declares_answer
cases.description: invoke_tool never carries an answer.

cases.name: agent_tool_on_answer_route
cases.description: A second tool on the answer tool's method and route would expose answering to agents.

cases.name: agent_tool_on_answer_route_other_placeholder
cases.description: Routes overlap when a placeholder segment can match the other's literal.

cases.name: agent_tool_declares_answer
cases.description: Only a surface answer_tool carries an answer, whatever the other tool's contexts.

cases.name: answer_tool_declares_answer
cases.description: The surface answer_tool is the one tool that may declare an answer.

cases.name: surface_invocation_not_body_object
cases.description: inputs.invocation names the invoke tool's JSON object body argument.

cases.name: surface_event_undeclared
cases.description: Manifest events must be declared before a surface binds them.

cases.name: surface_event_field_path
cases.description: Fixed opaque field names, not executable JSONPath.

cases.name: surface_unknown_field
cases.description: A manifest cannot provide network destinations inside surface data.

cases.name: hook_target_agent_visible
cases.description: Registrable hook targets declare exactly hook.

cases.name: hook_target_qualified_name
cases.description: tool is a local name; it cannot nominate another app.

cases.name: hook_production_read_mutation
cases.description: reads names local non-mutating tools.

cases.name: hooks_unknown_field
cases.description: The slot is strict; the catalog itself is not part of the manifest.

call_cases.name: agent_only_tool_dashboard
call_cases.description: A tool without surface refuses a dashboard caller.

call_cases.name: self_custodial_surface_only_refused
call_cases.description: A self-custodial member has no attestation; dashboard is never inferred.

call_cases.name: unverifiable_attestation_refused_not_downgraded
call_cases.description: A present attestation the verifier rejects (here a bad request binding) refuses the call even for an agent+surface tool; it is never treated as absent.

call_cases.name: unverifiable_attestation_agent_only_tool
call_cases.description: A dashboard-claiming attestation with a bad binding sent to an agent tool is refused.

answer_payload_cases.name: invoke_plain_request_not_refused

patch.answer: a record field may be named answer

answer_payload_cases.description: Only a top-level answer member is an answer payload; record data is not inspected.

answer_payload_cases.name: invoke_answer_null_still_refused
answer_payload_cases.description: Presence of the member is the payload, whatever its value.

answer_payload_cases.name: agent_tool_answer_payload_refused
answer_payload_cases.description: Every v2 tool except a surface answer_tool refuses an answer, not only invoke tools.

answer_payload_cases.name: invoke_non_object_body_not_inspected
answer_payload_cases.description: A non-object body is the tool's own validation problem, not an answer payload.
